comment: Deterministic Sentry issue classification. Ordered: first match wins. Patterns are case-insensitive and written in the common subset of Python re and JavaScript RegExp. Matched against '<exception type> <message>' in memory only; the message is never persisted. Language mirrors must pass classification-cases.jsonl, the shared parity corpus.

signatures.pattern: ModelNotFound|model .{0,40}not (found|exist)|AuthenticationError|PermissionDenied|\b40[13]\b|no api key|api key .{0,20}(missing|invalid)|not configured|missing (env|environment)|Cron failure
UndefinedColumn|UndefinedTable|relation ".{1,120}" does not exist|column ".{1,120}" does not exist|ProgrammingError|schema drift
